# S369 — UI pass can write its renders to its run temp dir

*Proposed.* A cloud UI pass may write files only under its own run temp dir (for rendered views), as a claude-local read-only role may write its progress note (adj 348). It still may not change the worktree.

**Findings:** S241 (2026-11-16, run ork-20261116-015040-d93b): the UI pass (claude opus, read-only, plan mode) was denied two Writes to `~/.local/state/ork/runs/RUN/` and reported tool feedback: "plan mode allowed writing only a plan file, so renders/*.txt could not be produced". · **Size:** S · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

*Proposed.* The UI pass prompt asks for rendered views to check layout; plan mode blocks every write but the plan file, so the pass reviews without them.
